// MARK: - DOCUMENT IDENTITY: Name and version of the specification this layout belongs to. Must match ife_constants.json byte for byte.
// MARK: - TYPE VOCABULARY: Every scalar width the format may use, plus alias chains. Dense packing, always little endian on disk; no field is ever padded for alignment.
// MARK: - PRIMITIVE BLOCK TYPES: The byte prefixes every block inherits. A block names one primitive; its own fields follow that primitive's chain. Offsets are derived by concatenation, never stated.

file_header.description: Root primitive. The file header is the one block reached without an offset - it is at byte 0 - so it carries no VALIDATION field, which would only ever store zero. It opens with the magic number that identifies the file.

1.0.name: MAGIC
1.0.description: ASCII 'Iris' (0x49726973). The first four bytes of every IFE file.

1.0.name: RECOVERY
1.0.description: Recovery tag identifying this block's type.

block.description: Universal primitive for every block reached through an offset field. VALIDATION stores the block's own byte offset, so a reader that arrived by pointer can confirm it landed where it intended, and a recovery scan can find the block by searching for a value equal to its own position.

1.0.name: VALIDATION
1.0.description: Byte offset of this block from the start of file.

1.0.name: RECOVERY
1.0.description: Recovery tag identifying this block's type.

array.description: A block carrying a sequence of fixed-width entries. STRIDE records the entry width at encoding time so a decoder steps by the stored value rather than its own compiled size; that is what lets a reader of one version traverse an array written by a later one.

1.0.name: STRIDE
1.0.description: Byte size of one array entry at the time of encoding.

1.0.name: COUNT
1.0.description: Number of entries.

byte_array.description: A block carrying an opaque run of bytes. It stores no STRIDE: the stride of a byte array is intrinsically one, so recording it would encode no information. COUNT is therefore a byte count. Strings live here - every string in IFE is a byte range whose length comes from a size field elsewhere.

1.0.name: COUNT
1.0.description: Number of bytes in the array.

// MARK: - BLOCK INVENTORY: Every data-block in the format, grouped by domain. Field lists are keyed by introducing version and concatenated in ascending order; no offset or size is ever stated.

blocks.// MARK: - HEADER BLOCKS: Fixed-size blocks. FILE_HEADER is the root at byte 0; every other block is reached only through an offset field.

FILE_HEADER.description: Root of the file structure; its universal header immediately follows the file preamble at byte offset 8.

1.0.name: FILE_SIZE
1.0.description: Total file size in bytes; serves as the atomic write-head during encoding.

1.0.name: EXTENSION_MAJOR
1.0.description: IFE specification major version used to encode this file. Read once at the root and propagated to every block; this is the sole version source.

1.0.name: EXTENSION_MINOR
1.0.description: IFE specification minor version used to encode this file.

1.0.name: FILE_REVISION
1.0.description: Monotonic modification counter for the file.

1.0.name: TILE_TABLE_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the tile table block.

1.0.name: METADATA_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the metadata block; required even when no optional metadata content is encoded.

TILE_TABLE.description: Information necessary to visually reconstruct the whole slide image.

1.0.name: ENCODING
1.0.description: Compression codec of the slide tile pixel data.

1.0.name: FORMAT
1.0.description: Pixel channel ordering and bit depth.

1.0.name: CIPHER_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the codec cipher block (reserved for the Iris Codec).

1.0.name: TILE_OFFSETS_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the tile offsets array.

1.0.name: LAYER_EXTENTS_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the layer extents array.

1.0.name: X_EXTENT
1.0.description: Width of the slide, in pixels, at the highest-resolution layer.

1.0.name: Y_EXTENT
1.0.description: Height of the slide, in pixels, at the highest-resolution layer.

CIPHER.description: Reserved for future use by the Iris Codec. The block is claimed so its recovery tag and position in the inventory are fixed; encoders write nothing beyond the universal header and readers ignore its contents. TILE_TABLE.CIPHER_OFFSET is nullable and is NULL_OFFSET in every file written to date.

METADATA.description: Slide metadata: encoder identification, offsets of optional structures, and physical-space conversion coefficients.

1.0.name: CODEC_MAJOR
1.0.description: Major version of the Iris Codec implementation that wrote the file; zero when not applicable.

1.0.name: CODEC_MINOR
1.0.description: Minor version of the writing codec; zero when not applicable.

1.0.name: CODEC_BUILD
1.0.description: Build number of the writing codec; zero when not applicable.

1.0.name: ATTRIBUTES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the attributes block, or NULL_OFFSET if no attributes are encoded.

1.0.name: IMAGES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the associated images array, or NULL_OFFSET if none are encoded.

1.0.name: ICC_COLOR_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the ICC color profile byte array, or NULL_OFFSET if none is encoded.

1.0.name: ANNOTATIONS_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the annotations array, or NULL_OFFSET if none are present.

1.0.name: MICRONS_PIXEL
1.0.description: Normalized microns of physical space per pixel at layer scale 1.

1.0.name: MAGNIFICATION
1.0.description: Normalized magnification coefficient converting layer scale to microscope objective magnification.

ATTRIBUTES.description: Header for key-value (or tag-value) clinical and acquisition metadata attributes.

1.0.name: FORMAT
1.0.description: The metadata standard by which the attributes were encoded.

1.0.name: VERSION
1.0.description: Version of the claimed metadata standard; zero when format is METADATA_FREE_TEXT.

1.0.name: SIZES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the attribute sizes array.

1.0.name: BYTES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the attribute byte array.

blocks.// MARK: - TILE DATA ARRAYS: The pyramid geometry and the tile lookup table — everything needed to locate and reconstruct slide tiles.

LAYER_EXTENTS.description: Pyramidal layer dimensions, ordered from lowest resolution (index 0) to highest.

1.0.name: X_TILES
1.0.description: Number of 256-pixel tiles in the horizontal direction.

1.0.name: Y_TILES
1.0.description: Number of 256-pixel tiles in the vertical direction.

1.0.name: SCALE
1.0.description: Relative scale of this layer as a multiple of the lowest-resolution layer's scale.

TILE_OFFSETS.description: Byte offset and size of each compressed tile stream, indexed by the global tile indexing scheme.

1.0.name: OFFSET
1.0.description: Byte offset of the compressed tile stream from SOF, or NULL_TILE when the tile is not encoded.

1.0.name: SIZE
1.0.description: Byte size of the compressed tile stream.

blocks.// MARK: - ATTRIBUTE ARRAYS: Clinical and acquisition key-value metadata: a slicing array and the packed byte array it slices.

ATTRIBUTE_SIZES.description: Slicing tuples converting the attribute byte array into key-value pairs.

1.0.name: KEY_SIZE
1.0.description: Byte length of the attribute key string (4 when encoded per the DICOM standard).

1.0.name: VALUE_SIZE
1.0.description: Byte length of the UTF-8 value string corresponding to the key.

ATTRIBUTE_BYTES.description: Tightly packed key and value strings sliced by the attribute sizes array.

blocks.// MARK: - ASSOCIATED IMAGES: Ancillary images such as labels and thumbnails: the entry array and the per-image label-plus-stream block.

IMAGES.description: Associated (ancillary) images such as labels and thumbnails.

1.0.name: BYTES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the image bytes block holding this image's label and compressed stream.

1.0.name: WIDTH
1.0.description: Horizontal pixel extent of the encoded image.

1.0.name: HEIGHT
1.0.description: Vertical pixel extent of the encoded image.

1.0.name: ENCODING
1.0.description: Compression codec of the image byte stream.

1.0.name: FORMAT
1.0.description: Pixel channel ordering of the decoded image.

1.0.name: ORIENTATION
1.0.description: Intended rendering rotation in degrees, IEEE half-precision, interpreted modulo 360. Any degree value is legal; the ORIENTATION_* constants are provided for convenience.

IMAGE_BYTES.description: One associated image's ASCII label followed by its compressed byte stream. Not an array: the payload length is TITLE_SIZE + IMAGE_SIZE, so the block needs neither STRIDE nor COUNT. The label is specified (ASCII); the stream that follows is defined by the referencing IMAGE_ENTRY.ENCODING value.

1.0.name: TITLE_SIZE
1.0.description: Byte length of the ASCII image label preceding the image bytes.

1.0.name: IMAGE_SIZE
1.0.description: Byte length of the compressed image stream following the label.

blocks.// MARK: - ICC COLOR PROFILE: An unmodified ICC colour profile, stored as an opaque byte array.

ICC_PROFILE.specified_by: ICC.1 colour profile specification (International Color Consortium)
ICC_PROFILE.description: Serialized contents of an ICC (.icc) color profile without modification. IFE specifies only that the bytes are stored verbatim and their length; their internal structure is defined by the ICC specification and deliberately not constrained here.

blocks.// MARK: - ANNOTATION ARRAYS: On-slide annotation objects, their raw visual-object streams, and the group tables that name and collect them.

ANNOTATIONS.description: On-slide annotation objects positioned and sized in slide space.

1.0.name: GROUP_SIZES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the annotation group sizes array, or NULL_OFFSET when no groups are encoded.

1.0.name: GROUP_BYTES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the annotation group bytes array, or NULL_OFFSET when no groups are encoded.

1.0.name: IDENTIFIER
1.0.description: Unique identifier tag of this annotation; never NULL_ID.

1.0.name: BYTES_OFFSET
1.0.description: Offset of the annotation byte array containing this annotation's visual object stream.

1.0.name: FORMAT
1.0.description: Byte format of the annotation visual object stream.

1.0.name: X_LOCATION
1.0.description: Horizontal origin (upper-left) of the annotation in slide space.

1.0.name: Y_LOCATION
1.0.description: Vertical origin (upper-left) of the annotation in slide space.

1.0.name: X_SIZE
1.0.description: Rendered width of the annotation in slide space.

1.0.name: Y_SIZE
1.0.description: Rendered height of the annotation in slide space.

1.0.name: PIXEL_WIDTH
1.0.description: Horizontal pixel dimension of the decoded/rasterized annotation object.

1.0.name: PIXEL_HEIGHT
1.0.description: Vertical pixel dimension of the decoded/rasterized annotation object.

1.0.name: PARENT_ID
1.0.description: Optional parent annotation identifier, or NULL_ID when no parent is referenced.

ANNOTATION_BYTES.specified_by: The annotation_types value carried by the referencing ANNOTATION_ENTRY.FORMAT field
ANNOTATION_BYTES.description: One annotation's raw visual-object byte stream. IFE specifies only where the bytes are and how many; their interpretation is determined by the annotation format the referencing entry declares, and is deliberately not constrained here.

ANNOTATION_GROUP_SIZES.description: Slicing tuples for decoding group titles and member-identifier lists from the group bytes array.

1.0.name: TITLE_SIZE
1.0.description: Byte length of the ASCII group title.

1.0.name: MEMBER_COUNT
1.0.description: Number of 24-bit annotation identifiers in the group.

ANNOTATION_GROUP_BYTES.description: Tightly packed group label strings each followed by that group's 24-bit annotation identifier sequence.
